creativeStrategy.designRationale: By blending a gallery-style layout with editorial structure, the site positions BOB not just as a salon, but as a lifestyle brand. The high-contrast typography honors the Vidal Sassoon heritage, while the velocity scroll and mask reveals add a modern, tech-forward 'revolutionary' edge.
